summary.text: Matt Lundy is the Democratic candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 53 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Bradley Lacko.
He previously served in the Ohio House of Representatives, representing District 55 from 2007 to 2014.

paragraphs.text: Matt Lundy earned an A.A. from Lorain County Community College and a B.S. in Human Resource Management from Friends University, and he later attended the M.B.A. program at Tiffin University.
His professional experience includes working as an assistant safety director for the City of Elyria and as an investigative reporter.
He has also served as a councilman-at-large for the City of Avon Lake.
Lundy assumed office in the Ohio House in 2007 and left it on December 31, 2014.

In the 2009-2010 session he served on committees including Education and Economic Development, and in 2013-2014 he served on the Commerce, Labor, and Technology; Finance and Appropriations; and State and Local Government committees.
He defeated Dan Nutt in the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary for District 53, with 74.3 percent of the vote.
